mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_HISTORY ( USER_ID, QUESTION, ANSWER, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{question}, #{answer}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP -- NOW() 대신 이거 사용! )
mapper.select: SELECT ID, USER_ID as userId, QUESTION, ANSWER, REG_DATE as regDate FROM CHAT_HISTORY WHERE USER_ID = #{userNo} ORDER BY REG_DATE ASC
